abstract: The subject of this retrospective study was to evaluate the potential benefit of the c-erbB-2 oncogene amplification and expression in 27 complete hydatidiform moles as well as in 9 cases of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease defined by elevated serum beta-human choriongonadotropin. The persistent cases were histopathologically classified as 5 complete hydatidiform moles, 3 invasive moles and 1 choriocarcinoma. In addition, we determined the DNA content and the karyotype of the sex chromosomes. The data were correlated with the histopathologic characteristics of gestational trophoblastic diseases. Cases with c-erbB-2 amplification and expression in combination with DNA hyperploidy showed higher proliferation and a more aggressive behavior (2 complete hydatidiform moles with lung and liver metastases, 2 invasive moles and 1 choriocarcinoma). XY karyotype was evident in the choriocarcinoma and in two complete hydatidiform moles with advanced stage and DNA hyperploidy.
abstract_ja: 本後方視的研究は、27例の完全胞状奇胎と、血清β-hCG高値により定義された9例の持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患において、c-erbB-2癌遺伝子の増幅と発現の潜在的有用性を評価することを目的とした。持続例は組織学的に、完全胞状奇胎5例、侵入奇胎3例、絨毛癌1例に分類された。さらに、DNA含量と性染色体の核型を測定した。得られたデータを、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織学的特徴と相関させた。c-erbB-2の増幅と発現に加えてDNA過倍数性を示した症例では、増殖が高く、より侵襲的な振る舞いを示した（肺および肝転移を伴う完全胞状奇胎2例、侵入奇胎2例、絨毛癌1例）。XY核型は絨毛癌と、進行期でDNA過倍数性を示した完全胞状奇胎2例で認められた。
